top_categories.workout_context: 60ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Big Sky Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Big Sky Gravel's Montana mountains, Local event forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 100 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Big Sky Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 100, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Big Sky Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 100 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
6,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
6,000ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 100 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
100 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Big Sky Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Big Sky Gravel’s 100 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Big Sky Gravel. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Big Sky Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on montana mountain gravel to build confidence. Expect: montana mountains, local event, mountain west gravel.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 100 miles of montana mountain gravel in Red Lodge, Montana.
